text:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Auto-detect - serving-runtime cluster eu-west1 is experiencing repeated container restarts. Metric: container_restarts(runtime)=124 in last 5m, error_rate(long-context)=3.1%. Paging oncall.

sam_oncall: I'm oncall, seeing spikes in 502/timeout for long-context endpoints. Which pool is this hitting? any recent changes?

deploy-bot: No deploys in flight. Last successful deploy 18m ago (ted_runtime).

maria_sre: quick triage: pods runtime-abc-7/9 on node g4-12 show CrashLoopBackOff. Logs contain repeated prefill OOMs during large-system-prompt workloads. nvidia-smi snapshot shows near-100% mem at prefill time.

ted_runtime: grabbing kube logs + dmesg + nvidia logs now, sending paste. initial runtime error: "RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 40.00 GiB total)". also see k8s event OOMKilled.

ana_support: Customer report: AcmeDocs noticed timeouts when submitting 500k char docs to /v1/generate. They got repeated 502s and had queue retries. Impact: some jobs failed end-to-end.

jordan_pd: setting severity P1 and paging infra-sre.

sam_oncall: Ok mitigation plan inline - quick steps we can do without a full deploy:
1) Auto-trim incoming prompts above 150k chars -> trim to 64k and add warning header.
2) Enable KV-cache eviction for sessions older than 60s to free prefix memory.
3) Route long-context traffic to larger-memory GPU pool (coldpool-rt) if capacity exists.
4) If still failing, enable fallback to cpu-backed cold-model for those requests.
Which can we flip now?

maria_sre: I can flip 1+2 via admin API. 3 requires scaling and might take minutes. 4 is last resort (higher latency).

ted_runtime: running admin call to enable prefix_trim and kv_eviction TTL=60s. I'll paste commands.

infra-bot: Command executed by ted_runtime at 5284123512:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/mitigations \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' \
  -d '{"mitigations": ["prefix_trim:150k->64k","kv_eviction_ttl_s:60"]}'
```

maria_sre: Done. Also increasing pod resource limit to allow ephemeral prefill swap: patching deployment.

ted_runtime: Patching deployment to allow higher host memory and set swap-to-coldmodel threshold lower.
```
kubectl -n runtime patch deployment runtime --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"48Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```

sam_oncall: Good. I'm also updating routing rules to divert traffic with header X-Context-Length:>150k to coldpool-rt.

deploy-bot: Route change applied by sam_oncall at 5284123580.

maria_sre: Observed immediate drop in restarts: container_restarts last 2m = 6 (was 124). Error rate for long-context endpoints down to 0.9%. Still seeing a handful of OOM log lines.

ted_runtime: grabbing an example error output for postmortem: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z runtime[pid=972]: CUDA error at aten::empty_cuda: out of memory, tried to allocate 1.15 GiB (GPU 0; 40.00 GiB total), available 256.00 MiB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/runtime/infer.py", line 412, in do_prefill
    kv = allocate_kv_cache(seq_len)
  File "/opt/runtime/alloc.py", line 88, in allocate_kv_cache
    raise RuntimeError("CUDA out of memory")
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
Also see k8s event: "Back-off restarting failed container" and node kernel messages about oom_killer targeting process 972.

ana_support: immediate customer mitigation applied: AcmeDocs requests >=150k chars are now being responded to with 200 + header X-Processing=degraded + body note about trimmed input. They confirmed reduced failures.

jordan_pd: summarizing customer impact: ~3% of their requests hit the long-context path; of those ~40% failed pre-mitigation. Estimated 12k affected requests in last hour. They are OK with degraded responses for now.

sam_oncall: Next steps:
- keep prefix_trim & kv_eviction enabled for next 2h
- scale up coldpool-rt by +3 nodes (maria to run)
- collect full core dump+nvml traces for postmortem (ted)
- create incident ticket and schedule follow-up triage in 1 business hour (jordan)

maria_sre: scaling coldpool-rt now (+3 gpus). Command: `scale pool coldpool-rt --add 3`. ETA ~3m.

ted_runtime: I've saved core dump + uploaded tar to s3://incidents/5284123456/core-dumps.tar.gz. nvml traces attached. Will run reproduce in staging with larger prompt to validate GC and eviction behavior.

infra-bot: Autoscaling result: coldpool-rt scaled +3 at 5284123705. Node readiness at 5284123748.

maria_sre: restarts stabilized across nodes; container_restarts now under threshold. Error rate for long-context at 0.2%.

sam_oncall: handoff notes for next oncall: keep mitigations for 2 hours, monitor container_restarts and long-context error_rate, if restarts remain >5/min then escalate to runtime eng for emergency rollback to older runtime image.

jordan_pd: incident ticket created: INC-20260315-5284123456. Assigning postmortem to ted_runtime + maria_sre.

ted_runtime: I'll own postmortem. Actions to include: workload size limits, better prefill memory accounting, early-trim client-side guidance, and option for per-customer routing to high-mem pools.

ana_support: Customer update draft: "We detected and mitigated a GPU memory issue causing retries for very long documents. We applied temporary trimming and routed very large requests to a higher-memory pool; we will follow up with a permanent fix and offer credits if needed."

sam_oncall: tagging for follow up and closing live page. Good job team :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation in place). Closing live page at 5284123799.
